svg.title: OIDC: Short-Lived Cloud Credentials per Job
svg.desc: A deploy job requests a JWT from GitHub's OIDC provider, the cloud checks the audience and the subject claim against the role's trust policy, and only a matching job receives short-lived credentials.
svg.text: OIDC: Short-Lived Cloud Credentials per Job
No stored key: the cloud trusts a signed token only when its claims match.
